summary: Decouple usage ingestion from route policy availability

delivery.outcome: Record validated, already completed provider-attempt metadata through the canonical journal even when current route policy or credential observation is unavailable. Retain schema, registry, idempotency, journal failure and all policy-operation controls.
nonGoals: No resolver edits, policy repair, provider calls, paid retries, credential access, backfill or runtime deployment.

architecture.decision: Select a truthful metadata-only observation for the fixed RECORD_USAGE_REF; retain full policy/credential observations for every other registered process. Reuse existing plan, binding, strict journal and event path.
architecture.rollback: Revert the reviewed process-specific observation selection.

commands: Actual loopback HTTP ingest under invalid routing policy and unavailable credential observation, including duplicate replay.
validation.evidence: One metadata row and completed event are stored; no provider or credential operation occurs.

commands: Invalid metadata and journal-unavailable rejection, unaffected policy process rejection, full tests, native governance, current-base OneDev and trusted Validator.
validation.evidence: All existing input, storage, registry and policy controls remain fail-closed; frozen head independently approved and merged.
